required_disclosures: Labels are AI-assisted (ChatGPT) and human-reviewed by one reviewer; they are not independent human annotation and no inter-annotator agreement was measured.

Because the labeling assistant and matcher are both OpenAI-family models, correlated model preferences may inflate apparent agreement. The direction and magnitude of this bias were not independently measured.
This deviates from the D-053 wording "no model suggestions"; recorded in D-088.
The headline covers three synthetic CVs (CV3-CV5); results are indicative only.
Unscorable pairs are unjudged, never counted as 0 (D-052).
